issues.description: The solution implementation declares some attribute getters as private (getLectureName, getNumberOfInscribedStudents) while the problem statement explicitly asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (implying public access). The template leaves getters as TODOs (no enforced visibility). This visibility mismatch between the problem description and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended API and may cause test or usage discrepancies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter methods public in the solution (change getLectureName and getNumberOfInscribedStudents from private to public) so they match the problem statement's requirement to implement getters for each attribute. Alternatively, update the problem statement to explicitly state which getters should be non-public if that was intentional.
